title: Attila D FDE 4106 NDE 4106
content: I had only passed my car driving test for a couple of weeks, but my dad let me drive his car as I never owned my own car at the time. The car was a Ford Granada 2.8 GL, which was a big car for a first time driver. Anyway, I picked my friend up and we went for a drive around Nottingham, we approached a sweeping bend, which as two lanes on either side of the road, the only separation of oncoming traffic is the center white line, I am doing forty mph overtaking a single decker bus. I try to drive past while on the bend, but the bus is going pretty fast too, and slowly drifting into my lane while I am overtaking it. The road is busy in the opposite direction; I remember seeing a blue or black Ford Fiesta coming towards me. The problem was that I went more towards the oncoming traffic due to the bus drifting out of the lane. At the point of impact, all I remember after that was a big flash like those old cameras they used many years ago were they put the material over their heads and they made a bit of smoke. It was a very big white flash. Then all I saw (which was in black and white) was like an old film reel flicking through my whole life very fast with little flashes. I saw my whole childhood from being in my mum's stomach, my parents holding me, who I had met in my family, my brothers, sisters, grandparents etc. It was very bizarre to me. The strange thing is that I drove from the point of impact and around a bend, sweeping left and then right over a train bridge where there were traffic lights at the bottom of the train bridge. I would say from the point of impact to the lights it is two hundred meters, but I woke up or whatever happened to me physically I have no idea at the traffic lights in a perfectly parked position with traffic driving around me. My friend was terrified curled up in the passenger seat pressed against the door very white shaking and said, 'What the f**k happened to you?!' I could not even speak. I did not know where I was. At first, I replied in a calming fashion, 'I don't know.' He said, 'Take me home!' I never saw or spoke with him since that evening. I would love to ask him what I was doing. It took me a lot to tell this story which I have had with me all these years. I am a caring loving person in general but I do know what I saw that day. When I finally got home, my dad and elder brother were in the kitchen when I got back home, and I just said I nearly had a head on crash and it frightened me so much that I did not want to drive again. My dad said it was due to lack of experience with a car, which I think is true, but I saw that car coming towards me and I thought I was going to die. It was around five years ago when my brother and me were talking about what happened and what I saw that day. He browsed the web and we came across NDEs and life reviews. It was so strange that the life review is what happened to me, so I have finally told the story. It's very true what I saw that day. I feel there is something out there now but I hope it was real at the same time.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He reports a white flash and rapid life-review imagery, then 'woke up' about 200 meters away at traffic lights with the car 'in a perfectly parked position'.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Abrupt 'woke up' at traffic lights with car parked; apparent gap in awareness from impact to that point.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: White flash/light first, then rapid life-review imagery; no tunnel/realm/being/boundary described; then abrupt return to awareness in car at traffic lights.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Life review presented as black-and-white 'old film reel' with flashes, occurring immediately after a camera-like white flash at impact; later regained awareness with vehicle apparently safely parked at traffic lights ~200 meters away.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “a big flash like those old cameras… It was a very big white flash.” “all I saw (which was in black and white) was like an old film reel flicking through my whole life very fast with little flashes.” “I woke up… at the traffic lights in a perfectly parked position with traffic driving around me.” “I feel there is something out there now but I hope it was real at the same time.”
